summary: Exel Composites Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pultruded composite profiles and tubes in Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It offers bus and coach, train and tram, truck and trailer, and automotive profiles; window and door and standard structural composite profiles, as well as sunshades, umbrellas, and awnings; wind turbines composites; 4G performance and dynamic, 5G macro and MIMO, and 5G small cell mmWave composites; and composites for frangible support structures, water and wastewater, utility power transmission and distribution, and rail solutions. The company also provides camouflage netting support and carbon fiber telescoping poles, as well as non-magnetic tool handles; composites for paper machines, composite conduit rods, textile machine solutions, and insulating and non-ferrous composite solutions; and composite tubes, telescoping poles, and tool handles. Its products are used in the transportation, buildings, wind power, telecommunication, infrastructure, defense, machinery and electrical, equipment, agriculture, sporting goods, oil and gas, and photography industries. The company was formerly known as Exel Oyj and changed its name to Exel Composites Oyj in April 2009. Exel Composites Oyj was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Vantaa, Finland.
